scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@mystery/shared && node -e "console.log('Run server and client with npm run dev --workspace=@mystery/server / client')"
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace=@mystery/shared && npm run build --workspace=@mystery/server
scripts.build:client: npm run build --workspace=@mystery/shared && npm run build --workspace=@mystery/client
